subject: Best performance for stochastic volatility model?

messages.author: 28e4cea0c0378ed9
messages.subject: Best performance for stochastic volatility model?
parts:
Dear Stan community,

I'm working on comparing the performance (i.e. effective samples per time) of stan to some other MCMC routines
for non-linear models with many latent variables. For this purpose I consider a simple stochastic volatility model.

Consequently, I wish to choose the best possible arguments to stan()-function in rstan, and also other possible
optimizations of the code that I have missed out on. Could anyone help me out?

I'm attached an R-script and also data so that it is easy to replicate what I am trying to get at.

Best regards and thanks in advance,

Tore Selland Kleppe
